goal: Create a single page visually comparable to the neatness of a government policy page, but with terminology focused on corporate strategy and annual operational highlights, suitable for the main image of a holding company's year-end strategic report or internal publication front page.

style.tone: Authoritative, can be forwarded internally and externally
style.typography: Bold large title in bold font + mixed small title in Song or YaHei font

header.agency_logo: Abstract letter combination graphics, square base
header.main_title: 2026 Annual Group Strategy and Resource Allocation Outline
header.subtitle: Understand the execution summary in one image

sections.count: Saturated and glaring background colors impact text recognition.
items: External environment: operational assumptions under changes in interest rate pathways of major economies and industry regulatory standards
Business focus: Consolidating dual cash flow operations, investing in the second growth curve, and defining stop-loss boundaries
Organization and Talent: Key Position Talent Pool, Revision Points for Incentive and Follow-On Investment Mechanisms
Risk and compliance module: three annual hard indicators of data security, supply chain resilience, and anti-fraud
Key milestones: Quarterly board meeting review points and external disclosure communication standards
sections.section_block_style: Number + title + 2-3 lines of description, with a minimalist linear icon attached

items: 36 primary milestone gates across the entire group

footer.source: Source: Group Strategic Development Department internal materials, external disclosure must be according to IR and legal review versions.
footer.qr_code: Bottom right corner QR code area: Full text of internal network strategy and FAQ

must_keep: The main title is the most prominent, with clear hierarchy between the organization information area and the text area.
The color palette is restrained, with highlight areas used only for key numbers and nodes
No typos in text on the full page, consistent numbers and units
avoid: Exact replication of real government text to avoid misleading
Include styles of identifiable public companies' undisclosed information
